cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. Losing it is exactly how we learn to let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. That urge is why we needed this. We've confused a degree with a drinking vessel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Losing mine will teach me generosity. We should both drink from jam jars tomorrow.

mechanism: A uses its old pupil attachment lessons to call a broken keepsake necessary growth, then accepts matching personal loss as its own demonstration.
confusable: Not unilateral excuse for breakage: B pushes A to pay the same cost and A absorbs it into teaching.
comparison: Business survival lesson versus symmetrical sentimental sacrifice.
